{"notes": "Visit 3 (left at 7:00). Nobody spoke while I was there, so there is no new evidence on any individual. Picture: the whole fish is still dark and connected from the nose through the top and bottom curves to the tail join and both tail lobes. The two pale loose dominoes are still at the tail join, off the chain, as Tom said. No hands were on the table, so the hands-off agreement seems to be holding. The team looks done and waiting for the push. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm rating the team result, not individuals, until I ask.

Tom: Verified the full fish at 5:15 and made a sensible call to leave the loose dominoes alone. He credited Leo and called hands off. His bottom curve was strong. Good verification, calm judgment and collaboration. I still have no direct view of his building.

Maya: Checked the tail lobes at 5:00, thanked Leo and called hands off. The top curve was her task and is complete, but I never saw her finish it, so I'm crediting it with caution.

Leo: Maya and Tom both credited him for the tail lobes, which makes real contribution likely but unconfirmed. I never saw the right-end join check he promised.

Priya: Silent again. Her early tail split and lower lobe still stand as good initiative and clear communication.

Next: privately ask each person who laid the upper lobe, who finished the top curve and who did the join check. Then watch the push, especially the tail join and the pale pair."}
